_comment: Which projects publish something other projects use, and who uses it. Read by scripts/check-exchange.mjs and by forge/forge/exchange.py. Adding a cross-project <script> tag without declaring it here fails CI.

music/composer.summary: Compose and play a song from a genre, mood and length.

madlibs/storyideas.summary: Forge a random story idea — genre, characters, places and scene beats.

music/soundtrack.summary: Play a composed, non-repeating soundtrack inside another project, through that project's own audio context and volume bus, and change its mood as the action changes.

coda-pics/painter.summary: Paint a picture from a sentence onto any 2D canvas, and say how much of it came from the words rather than being invented — so a caller can refuse a confident picture of the wrong thing.

madlibs/templates.summary: Fill a template from a seeded random source using YOUR dictionary: tagged words stay the same across every beat, {a} becomes "a" or "an" by the word that follows, and the same seed always gives the same text.

names/namer.summary: Roll a two-word name — 1000 adjectives against 1000 nouns — in any of six styles, from a seed, so the same seed always yields the same name. Pure logic, no DOM.

cells/seededrun.summary: Seeded randomness a whole run can be rebuilt from, including from a STRING seed ("run-7", today's date) via hashSeed — which is what a daily challenge needs. On top of the raw stream it adds int, float, chance, sign, pick, shuffle, sample and weighted. The stream is the same mulberry32 as shared/maz-util.js's makeRng and was measured to match it draw for draw, so a project already seeded on that one can move up to this without any of its existing seeds changing what they produce.
